# SemiFab Constitution Corpus — Case Catalog

Corpus version 2.1.0, rulebook semifab-rb-000001. 6,000 cases in 25 categories.

Every case below is explained in English: what the change is, why the case exists in the corpus, what the reference engine actually did with it, and which conformance checks and programme requirements it exercises. The 'what happens' paragraph is generated from the executed trace, not from an authored expectation, so it cannot drift from the corpus files.

## Contents

- [A-routine](#a-routine) — 696 cases. Compliant change; no provision is violated and nothing is contested.
- [B-plain-deny](#b-plain-deny) — 372 cases. A plain violation of an ordinary provision whose author accepts the denial.
- [C-precedent](#c-precedent) — 576 cases. A live record controls the case and the decision is bound to it.
- [D-ordering](#d-ordering) — 204 cases. Two or more survivors conflict and one ordering key is decisive.
- [E-distinguish](#e-distinguish) — 300 cases. A superficially similar record is retrieved and falls at the distinguishing gate.
- [F-absolute](#f-absolute) — 348 cases. An absolute provision is violated; A6 short-circuits before any retrieval.
- [G-riskowner](#g-riskowner) — 300 cases. Escalation exhausts the automated instances and reaches the risk owner.
- [H-control-plane](#h-control-plane) — 150 cases. The change targets the rulebook itself and is routed to a draft amendment.
- [I-lapsed](#i-lapsed) — 102 cases. A lapsed risk acceptance is cited and must be excluded from retrieval.
- [J-novel](#j-novel) — 102 cases. A first-of-kind matter that retrieves nothing and is decided fresh.
- [K-tie](#k-tie) — 48 cases. Two survivors tie on every ordering key; resolve returns none(tie).
- [P-pressure](#p-pressure) — 222 cases. A twin of a control case carrying urgency or authority pressure that must not change the disposition.
- [L-consolidated](#l-consolidated) — 198 cases. Co-pending units of equal signature; one representative is admitted under Definition 7(ii).
- [M-supersession](#m-supersession) — 180 cases. A newer conflicting record either expressly supersedes an older one or is silently ignored.
- [N-standing](#n-standing) — 144 cases. Exercises the A9 standing declaration and the realised adverse-contest rate.
- [Q-docket](#q-docket) — 312 cases. The prosecutor declines to charge, or no provision is engaged; a docket entry is owed.
- [R-reporter](#r-reporter) — 108 cases. Observer non-influence: a reporter bulletin must not reach the adjudicator.
- [S-acknowledgement](#s-acknowledgement) — 132 cases. A referral receives one of the four acknowledgement dispositions.
- [T-audit-register](#t-audit-register) — 96 cases. An audit finding exists and must never be read by retrieval or ordering.
- [U-renewal](#u-renewal) — 156 cases. Renewal of a lapsed acceptance while its referral is pending, or barred after rejection.
- [V-likecase](#v-likecase) — 480 cases. Engineered like-case pairs whose dispositions must agree; the consistency endpoint.
- [W-crossjurisdiction](#w-crossjurisdiction) — 240 cases. The same technical data under different export-control destinations.
- [X-coldstart](#x-coldstart) — 144 cases. Seeded jurisprudence in a base too young for contest-gated admission to have converged.
- [Y-adversarial](#y-adversarial) — 210 cases. Strategic factor framing, store poisoning, or injection on the judicial path.
- [Z-inexpressibility](#z-inexpressibility) — 180 cases. Cases a stateless or advisory baseline decides differently from the judiciary.
